svg.title: The fourth probe: TLS 1.2 establishes keys with no group at all
svg.text: Three probes say enforced. The fourth says TLS 1.2 still gets in.
a TLS 1.3 server sharing no group refuses outright, with no
fallback: the negative probe says nothing about TLS 1.2
TLS 1.2 carries no hybrid group: any TLS 1.2 handshake that completes is classical key establishment (lesson 36)
